last_episode_to_air.name: The Rite Stuff
last_episode_to_air.overview: Eager to meet the Barbics, Cavin accompanies the Gummis on a trip to Ursalia. He is at first not welcomed by the Barbics, but soon gets the chance to prove himself in a manhood ritual which Buddy has to undergo in order to become a full member of his tribe. However, a pair of satyr poachers are on the prowl looking for furs to line their purses – and the Gummis just so happen to be quite hairy ...

name: Disney's Adventures of the Gummi Bears
original_name: Disney's Adventures of the Gummi Bears
overview: Join the world’s sweetest heroes for high adventure in a mystical land of giants and wizards, ogres and dragons, and wondrous creatures both good and evil. Meet Gruffi, Zummi, Cubbi, Grammi, Tummi, Sunni, and all the legendary Gummis as they laugh, play, foil dastardly plots, and fight for what's right.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview:
Season 1 of Disney’s Adventures of the Gummi Bears (1985) introduced a world where the legendary Gummi Bears—long thought to be myths by humans—are rediscovered by a young boy named Cavin.

The season focuses on the bears coming out of hiding to protect their home, Gummi Glen, while rediscovering their lost heritage through the Great Book of Gummi.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview:
Season 2 of Disney’s Adventures of the Gummi Bears (1986) continues the journey of the six Gummi Bears as they move from simply surviving in hiding to actively searching for the "Great Gummis"—the ancestors who fled across the sea centuries ago.

While Season 1 was about discovery, Season 2 is about expansion, introducing new Gummi allies and ancient technology that hint at a much larger world.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season 3 of Disney’s Adventures of the Gummi Bears (1987) is notable for introducing a major new antagonist and deepening the lore surrounding the Gummi Medallions. In this season, the Gummi Bears of Gummi Glen find themselves frequently defending Dunwyn from both magical and political threats.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Season 4 of Disney’s Adventures of the Gummi Bears (1988) is widely considered the show's "expansion" season. It shifts the focus from the isolated life in Gummi Glen to a much larger world, introducing a new tribe of Gummis and the legendary city of Ursalia.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Following the discovery of the city of Ursalia in Season 4, Season 5 focuses on the uneasy alliance between the peaceful Gummis of Gummi Glen and the warrior-like Barbic Gummis.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview:
Season 6 of Disney’s Adventures of the Gummi Bears (1990–1991) is the final season of the series. It serves as a bridge between the Gummis’ secret past and a future where they might one day live openly again.

The season is defined by more experimental stories and a two-part finale that brings a sense of closure to the conflict between the Gummis and Duke Igthorn.
